study type: Retrospective analysis and systematic literature review
exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of Truncus arteriosus communis (TAC)
outcome: Course and outcome of affected pregnancies
cohort: The local cohort included 14 cases of fetuses diagnosed prenatally with Truncus arteriosus communis (TAC) between 2019 and 2024; the systematic review included 823 TAC cases (576 prenatally diagnosed, 247 postnatally).
finding: Advances in prenatal imaging and early diagnosis have improved TAC management, allowing for detailed delivery planning and immediate postnatal care, with early surgical intervention being crucial for better outcomes despite significant risks and common associations with genetic syndromes.
